name: Criterion 5: Infrastructure & CI/CD Evaluation Set
description: Evaluates containerization, Cloud Run serverless readiness, CI/CD automated pipelines, and test coverage.

eval_cases.name: Production Multi-Stage Dockerfile
eval_cases.description: Validates multi-stage Docker build, unprivileged runtime, uvicorn entrypoint, and optimized layer caching.

rubrics.description: Dockerfile must adhere to Google Cloud Run container best practices.

eval_cases.name: Google Cloud Build Automated CI/CD Pipeline
eval_cases.description: Verifies cloudbuild.yaml has steps for linting, pytest, adk conformance, docker build, artifact push, and cloud run deployment.

rubrics.description: Cloud Build definition must automate testing, security scans, and deployment.

eval_cases.name: GitHub Actions Continuous Integration
eval_cases.description: Verifies .github/workflows/agent-ci.yml triggers on PR and push, runs pytests, and executes ADK conformance checks.

rubrics.description: CI workflow must be properly structured to run on commits and pull requests.

eval_cases.name: Pytest Suite & Conformance Automation
eval_cases.description: Verifies that all 21 unit and integration test cases pass with 100% success rate.

rubrics.description: 100% of test cases in tests/ must pass without failures or errors.
